## Source
.design/m5/45-ml-classifier.md — REQ-1, AC-1 (proto shape) + decomposition PR 1.

## Surface
- New file: `proto/polaris-classifier-v1.proto`
- New workspace member: `polaris-classifier-proto/`
  - `build.rs` invokes `tonic_build::compile_protos("../proto/polaris-classifier-v1.proto")` — codegen-on-build for proto packages is acceptable per tonic convention; output to `OUT_DIR` and re-exported from `src/lib.rs`.
  - `src/lib.rs` re-exports the generated module tree
- Optional: add the codegen step to a `cargo xtask gen-classifier-proto` for parity with the lexicons codegen pattern (#102), so CI can verify the build.rs output stays stable.

## Proto shape (verbatim from design)
```proto
service Classifier {
  rpc Classify(ClassifyRequest) returns (ClassifyResponse);
  rpc ClassifyStream(stream ClassifyRequest) returns (stream ClassifyResponse);
  rpc Feedback(FeedbackRequest) returns (FeedbackResponse);
  rpc HealthCheck(google.protobuf.Empty) returns (HealthResponse);
}
```

## Rust-quality notes
- `polaris-classifier-proto` is a leaf crate: depends only on `tonic`, `prost`. NO workspace consumers in this PR (`polaris-backend` integration is PR 2).
- Generated code lives in `OUT_DIR` (build.rs convention) — DO NOT commit generated `.rs` files. The diff-stability check is "build.rs runs cleanly + proto hash matches checked-in `.proto`".
- Per rust-quality §3: `polaris-classifier-proto`'s `lib.rs` has `#![deny(missing_docs)]` overridden ONLY for the generated tree via `#[allow(missing_docs)]` on the `tonic::include_proto!` macro invocation. Document the override with a comment.
- Proto field names use `snake_case` per Google style guide; tonic converts these to `snake_case` Rust fields per its config.
- `ClassifyRequest` carries: `event_id: String`, `subject_did: String`, `text_content: bytes` (optional), `image_blob_cid: String` (optional), `model_hint: String` (optional). `ClassifyResponse` carries: `model: String`, `labels: repeated Label { value: String, confidence: float }`, `model_version: String`.

## External references
- tonic build setup: https://docs.rs/tonic-build/latest/tonic_build/
- Google proto3 style guide: https://protobuf.dev/programming-guides/style/
- proto best practices: https://protobuf.dev/programming-guides/proto3/

## Acceptance
- [ ] `cargo build -p polaris-classifier-proto` succeeds.
- [ ] `cargo doc -p polaris-classifier-proto --no-deps` succeeds (docs reach the generated tree).
- [ ] The proto compiles cleanly with `protoc` standalone (sanity check that nothing tonic-specific leaked into the schema).
